title: Thus Spoke Zarathustra
author: Friedrich Nietzsche
summary: Nietzsche presents his ideas through the prophet Zarathustra, who descends from the mountains to teach about the overman, the death of God and eternal recurrence, in a deliberately poetic, scripture-like voice.
readIf: you want to meet Nietzsche's ideas in his most literary and provocative form.
skipIf: you want clear, systematic argument rather than aphorism, parable and metaphor.
